fato_historico: 1933: The Diexi earthquake strikes Mao County, Sichuan, China and kills 9,000 people.
energia_do_dia: Today, your fiery spirit may find profound strength in resilience. Much like the earth shifting and rebuilding in ancient stories of old, your heart is capable of transforming challenges into growth. It is a good time to consider how your inner warmth can comfort those around you, turning deep, heavy vibrations into a path of healing, rebirth, and renewed sunshine.
frase_do_dia: Even the strongest ground finds a new way to bloom after the shaking stops.
significado_numero: Represents the bridge between personal intuition and collective healing power.
conselho: Trust your inner light to guide you through any unexpected emotional tremors today.
